verdict.rationale: Cursor documents launching 'fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks' and always-on agents running on schedules/triggers, which suggests some capacity for parallel/bulk automation, but there is no explicit documentation of applying a single operation across many discrete items (e.g., bulk file edits, batch refactors) as a first-class feature. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-item operation documentation, hands-on/independent verification of parallel agent fleets working on distinct items, and examples of scale (how many items/tasks can run concurrently).
